section.title: Engagement Lock
section.purpose: Set measurable outcome, target, constraints, proof and commercial value before discovery expands.

questions.title: Company name
questions.recommendation: Use the legal or operating name the client expects in reports.

questions.title: Primary website
questions.prompt: What is the primary public website or URL?
questions.recommendation: Discover this before asking the client.

questions.title: Decision owner
questions.prompt: Who can make final decisions for this engagement?
questions.recommendation: One accountable human owner is required.

questions.title: 90-day outcome
questions.prompt: What measurable business result must this engagement produce within 90 days?
questions.recommendation: Choose one outcome tied to revenue, savings, retention, risk reduction or validated learning.

questions.title: Primary target
questions.prompt: Who or what is the system primarily improving?
questions.recommendation: Choose the party whose outcome matters most.

questions.title: Must not change
questions.prompt: What must not be replaced, disrupted, exposed or automated?
questions.recommendation: Record systems, relationships, compliance boundaries and owner-control requirements.

questions.title: Proof of success
questions.prompt: What evidence must exist before anyone may call this engagement successful?
questions.recommendation: Use observable acceptance tests and production evidence.

questions.title: Economic value
questions.prompt: What would make this engagement clearly worth paying for?
questions.recommendation: Translate value into dollars, hours, conversion, retention, avoided risk or validated learning.

questions.title: Portfolio classification
questions.prompt: Should this engagement be SELL, USE, MERGE, PARK or ARCHIVE?
questions.recommendation: Client delivery should normally be SELL; internal Client Zero work may be USE.
